headline: Pixel 11 Event Live Blog: Trevor Noah Hosts Google's New Phone Launch
summary: Google's Pixel 11 keynote event is live, featuring new hardware. Trevor Noah is hosting the celebrity-packed broadcast this year. Expect potential 'cringefest' moments, similar to previous years.

headline: 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard with Dual Super Buttons on Sale
summary: 8BitDo's retro mechanical keyboard is 30% off on Amazon. The bundle, including Dual Super Buttons, is priced at $69.99. This deal marks one of the lowest prices seen for the stylish keyboard.

headline: Petlibro Smart Feeders Outage Leaves Pets Hungry
summary: A Petlibro outage has caused smart pet feeders to fail scheduled tasks. Users report devices like feeders and litter boxes are offline. Pets are missing meals due to the widespread service disruption.

headline: Kinetic Publishing Unveils Five Ambitious New Indie Games
summary: Kinetic Publishing, from the Phasmophobia team, held its first game showcase. Five new ambitious titles are set for release in 2027 and 2028. The publisher will also release the next game from Telling Lies and Her Story creator Sam Barlow.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Writers Claim Jean Grey 'Technically' Killed No One
summary: Screenwriters for 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' address Jean Grey's actions. They assert Jean Grey 'technically' didn't kill anyone in the movie. The clarification adds a nuanced perspective to the character's portrayal.

headline: MTG x Marvel Commander Deck Bundle Hits Lowest Price on Amazon
summary: The MTG x Marvel Commander Deck bundle is on sale for $199.99 at Amazon. This limited-time restock deal saves buyers $100. Get all four decks at an unprecedented low price.

headline: Target Offers 20% Off GTA 6 and Marvel's Wolverine Preorders for Students & Teachers
summary: Target is offering a 20% discount on GTA 6 and Marvel's Wolverine preorders. This 'Back-to-School' promotion is exclusive to students and teachers. The limited-time deal applies to two highly anticipated game titles.

headline: Saber Interactive to Add AI Label to 'Rideshare Stimulator' on Steam
summary: Saber Interactive will add an AI label to 'Rideshare Stimulator' on Steam. This decision follows public criticism regarding the game's use of AI. The publisher aims to address controversy surrounding the title.

headline: Met Chief Acknowledges Mistakes in Simon Levy Case, Defends Murder Investigation
summary: The Met chief admits mistakes in the handling of the Simon Levy case. Critics accused the Met of overlooking Levy's first murder. Despite criticism, the chief defends the overall murder investigation.

headline: Spectacular Solar Eclipse Captivates Millions Across UK and Europe
summary: A rare solar eclipse enthralled millions across the UK and Europe. Over 95% of the Sun was obscured in Cornwall, UK. Parts of Spain witnessed the awe-inspiring spectacle of a total eclipse.

headline: UK Defends Seizure of Shadow Fleet Tanker Amid Putin's Threats
summary: The UK government defends seizing a 'shadow fleet' tanker. This action comes after threats made by President Putin. The UK states it is legally 'disrupting and deterring' such vessels.

headline: Travis Kelce Shares First Details on Wedding to Taylor Swift
summary: Travis Kelce opened up about his wedding to Taylor Swift. He called Swift his 'wife' for the first time in comments. Kelce described getting married at Madison Square Garden as a 'childhood dream.'
